alt: The words studio 91 in 3D text and a round sign with a yellow top reading NH and a gray bottom reading 44 sit on a white dotted grid surface, next to rolls of teal, orange and pink paper and a green ruler.
caption: 3D lettering for studio 91 and an NH route 44 shield on a dotted work surface with colored paper rolls and a ruler
description: A tabletop composition displays the words studio 91 in dark raised lettering next to a circular sticker representing New Hampshire route 44, which has a yellow top half and a gray bottom half with white numbers. The items sit on a white surface with a dot grid, surrounded by rolls of teal, orange and pink paper, flat sheets in similar colors, and a green inch ruler in the corner.
